福爾摩沙小導遊臺南 Tainan・北區

開元寺Kaiyuan Temple

這座寺院的前身，是鄭成功的兒子為母親所建的園林別館。1680 年，鄭經在這裡建了北園別館，奉養母親董夫人，也作為自己靜養的居所。清朝領台後，別館在 1690 年改建為佛寺，後定名開元寺。山門口立著一藍獅、一白象，是文殊菩薩與普賢菩薩的座騎。三川門的門神，是名師蔡草如 1972 年的作品。門旁的窗聯是林朝英的墨寶；他的「竹葉體」，每一筆都像一片飄落的竹葉。大銅鐘鑄於 1695 年：一千六百斤的銅，鐘身鐫著整部《心經》。二戰期間，它是台南唯一逃過金屬回收的古鐘；其他古鐘都堆在運河邊等著被運走。後方有鄭經井、白色海螺化石，還有相傳董夫人親手種的七弦竹。1930 年，在地詩社把詩稿埋在這裡，並立下「詩魂」碑，免得後人忘了詩睡在哪裡。

This monastery began as a garden villa, built by Koxinga's son for his mother. In 1680, Zheng Jing built the Beiyuan Villa here, as a home for his mother, Lady Dong, and as his own retreat. After the Qing took Taiwan, the villa became a Buddhist monastery in 1690. It was later named Kaiyuan Temple. At the mountain gate stand a blue lion and a white elephant, the mounts of Manjushri and Samantabhadra. The door gods on the triple gate were painted by the master Tsai Tsao-ju in 1972. Beside the doors are window couplets by Lin Chao-ying. In his bamboo-leaf strokes, every line looks like a drifting leaf. The great bronze bell was cast in 1695: 1,600 catties of bronze, with the full Heart Sutra engraved around its body. During World War Two, it was the only ancient bell in Tainan that escaped the metal collection. Behind, find the Zheng Jing Well, a white conch fossil, and the seven-string bamboo said to be planted by Lady Dong. In 1930, local poetry societies buried their poems here and raised the Poet's Soul stele, so no one would forget where the poems slept.

為什麼值得來

Why it matters & history

開元寺是台灣最古老的寺院之一，前身是鄭經為母親所建的北園別館。寺裡有 1695 年鑄的大銅鐘、林朝英的竹葉體墨寶、鄭經井和七弦竹，一座寺院串起明鄭、清代到日治的故事。

Kaiyuan Temple is one of the oldest Buddhist temples in Taiwan. It began as a garden villa that Zheng Jing built for his mother, and it keeps a bronze bell cast in 1695, Lin Chao-ying's bamboo-leaf calligraphy and Zheng Jing's well.

  1. 1680鄭經建北園別館奉養母親董夫人。Zheng Jing builds the Beiyuan villa for his mother, Lady Dong.
  2. 1690清朝領台後改建為佛寺，後定名開元寺。Under Qing rule the villa becomes a Buddhist temple, later named Kaiyuan.
  3. 1695鑄成大銅鐘，鐘身刻著整部《心經》。The great bronze bell is cast with the full Heart Sutra on it.
  4. 二戰 WWII古鐘是台南唯一逃過金屬回收的古鐘。It is the only old bell in Tainan to escape the wartime metal drive.
  5. 1930在地詩社埋下詩稿，立「詩魂」碑。A local poetry society buries its poems here and sets up the Soul of Poetry stone.

認識景點

About the place

寺院：出家人居住、修行的地方。開元寺是台灣最古老的寺院之一。 別館／靜養處：有庭園的宅邸，也是安靜休養的地方。鄭經為母親建了北園別館。 銅鐘、梵鐘：用青銅鑄成的大鐘。開元寺古鐘鑄於 1695 年。 文物：從過去留下來的珍貴物品。寺裡的文物很豐富。

monastery: A place where Buddhist monks live and pray. Kaiyuan Temple is one of Taiwan's oldest. villa / retreat: A garden house, and a quiet place to rest. Zheng Jing built one for his mother. bronze bell: A big bell made of bronze. This one was cast in 1695. relic: A precious old object from the past. The temple keeps many.

庭院：被建築圍起來的空地。寺裡的庭院有松鼠在玩。 藍獅與白象：文殊菩薩與普賢菩薩的座騎，是「這裡是佛寺」的記號。 門神：畫在廟門上的守護神。這裡的門神是蔡草如 1972 年畫的。 對聯：成對掛在兩旁的字句。林朝英用「竹葉體」書寫。

courtyard: An open space surrounded by buildings. Squirrels play in the temple courtyards. blue lion and white elephant: The mounts of Manjushri and Samantabhadra. They show this is a Buddhist temple. door gods: Guardian figures painted on temple doors. Tsai Tsao-ju painted these in 1972. couplet: A pair of written lines hung side by side. Lin Chao-ying wrote them in bamboo-leaf strokes.

《心經》：一部簡短的佛經，全文刻在古鐘上。 住持：寺院的主持僧人。開山住持為古鐘募款。 井：挖來取水的深洞。鄭經井供應王府的日常用水。 化石：非常古老的生物留下的石頭遺骸。這裡挖出過白色海螺化石。

Heart Sutra: A short Buddhist scripture. The full text is engraved on the bell. abbot: The head monk of a monastery. The founding abbot raised funds for the bell. well: A deep hole dug for water. The Zheng Jing Well served the prince's household. fossil: The stone remains of something very old. A white conch fossil was dug up here.

七弦竹：竹莖上有七條細紋，宛如琴弦。 石碑：刻著文字的直立石塊。「詩魂」碑標示詩稿埋藏的地方。

seven-string bamboo: Its stems carry seven fine lines, like the strings of a zither. stele: An upright stone with writing on it. The Poet's Soul stele marks where poems were buried.

實景照片

Photos on site

開元寺山門 The mountain gate

這是開元寺的山門，四周有高大的老樹。紅色屋頂上站著鳥形裝飾，中間是一個法輪，它是佛教的標誌。開元寺的前身，是鄭經在 1680 年為母親蓋的北園別館。

This is the mountain gate of Kaiyuan Temple, among tall old trees. Bird figures stand on its red roof, around a Dharma wheel, a symbol of Buddhism. The temple began as the Beiyuan Villa, built by Zheng Jing for his mother in 1680.

小西天 Little Western Heaven

從三川門望進去，可以看到後面的殿堂。門上的匾寫著「小西天」：「西天」指佛陀的國度，這裡就像一個小小的西天。1690 年，別館改建為佛寺，最早叫「海會寺」，是台灣歷史最悠久的佛寺之一。

Through the triple gate you can see the hall behind. The plaque says Little Western Heaven. The West means the land of the Buddha. In 1690, the villa became a Buddhist temple, first called Haihui Temple. It is one of the oldest Buddhist temples in Taiwan.

醜女改容 The ugly girl transformed

牆上的浮雕在說佛陀的故事。一位國王的女兒長得很醜，被關在家裡。她誠心遙拜佛陀，佛陀現身，她就變得像天女一樣美麗。故事告訴我們：真誠的心最美。

This wall panel tells a story of the Buddha. A king's daughter was born very ugly and was kept at home. She bowed to the Buddha with all her heart, and she became as beautiful as a heavenly maiden. A sincere heart is the most beautiful.

船師悔責 The boatman is sorry

另一幅浮雕：佛陀來到恆河邊，船夫要收渡船錢，佛陀沒有錢，船夫就不肯載他。佛陀從空中飛渡過河，船夫看了，心裡非常後悔。

In another panel, the Buddha comes to the Ganges River. The boatman wants a fare, but the Buddha has no money, so the boatman will not take him. The Buddha crosses through the air, and the boatman is very sorry.

伏虎羅漢 The Tiger-Taming Arhat

這幅彩色浮雕裡，一位羅漢正和老虎搏鬥，他是「伏虎羅漢」，十八羅漢之一。羅漢是佛陀弟子中修行有成的聖者。

In this colourful relief, an arhat wrestles a tiger. He is the Tiger-Taming Arhat, one of the Eighteen Arhats. An arhat is a wise follower of the Buddha.

降龍羅漢 The Dragon-Taming Arhat

這位羅漢站在海中的岩石上，手拿寶珠，面對雲裡的龍，他是「降龍羅漢」。降龍和伏虎，是十八羅漢裡最後加上的兩位。

This arhat stands on rocks in the sea and holds up a pearl to face a dragon in the clouds. He is the Dragon-Taming Arhat. He and the Tiger-Taming Arhat are the last two of the Eighteen Arhats.
